claims.statement: The army of Louis XII conquers the duchy and Ludovico Sforza flees. Later tradition says French troops damaged the clay model of the Sforza horse.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard chronologies; the model's fate rests on later sources.
